notes: TBox revision. R1: every current DJIA member is headquartered in the United States; past members were not all (International Nickel / Inco, a component until 1987, had its head office in Toronto), so the rule is about today's members; the committee's guideline asks for U.S. incorporation and headquarters. The questions ask the country, so moves within the U.S. do not matter. Derivability very_unlikely (was "unlikely" before 2026-11-11, when only the two ends became allowed): the rule is stated in its headquarters form ("30 large, publicly owned companies based in the United States", 144) and as "30 large U.S. companies" (151). The three derived queries name invented companies (Harrowgate Systems, Pellworth Health, Corran Dynamics) with their membership in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops). Real members (Coca-Cola, McDonald's) are not asked: their headquarters is stored by name, and three models did not even hold McDonald's membership. The third is an application: the country line of a parcel address. Migration (2026-11-11): the two indeterminate queries, their worlds and checks were dropped (TBox is determinate only); a disjunction was added. No name leaks the answer ('Dow Jones' names people; 道琼斯 is a transliteration). Near query: the number of members (30), not the edit's new value.
